description: Mulders, Sebastiaan Paul and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented optimisation tunes individual pitch-control gains and azimuth settings for one- and two-per-revolution control components. The source evaluates the resulting turbine-control behaviour in its stated model setting. This supports load-oriented control design and parameter selection for wind turbines. It does not establish one universally optimal gain set or independently distributed executable software. The record retains the distinction between an implemented optimisation procedure and a general-purpose controller deployment package. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
